capabilities: Create source notes with video details and readable or timestamped transcripts from YouTube URLs
Generate AI summaries and study notes using OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, or compatible services
Batch-generate multiple notes from a queued list of URLs
Combine a playlist or channel selection into one note or one note per video
Add optional TL;DR callouts, Mermaid mind maps, and quotes to generated notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed setup, usage, provider configuration, and troubleshooting guides live on separate documentation pages referenced from the README, which only covers installation and a first-run outline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn YouTube videos, playlists, or channels into organized Markdown notes with transcripts and metadata.

relations.evidence: connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, or another compatible service
